postal_system.postcode_rule: The January 2013 UPU sheet documents a five-digit format and routing hierarchy, and five-digit strings remain visible in official address lines. The 2013 National Assembly statement says 10101 was a proposal not representative of a particular location, while the current ZICTA page still describes a National Addressing and Postcode Project. A current assignment therefore requires a permitted successful ZAMPOST or ZICTA observation or a release-pinned rights-cleared directory; syntax, dated examples, a government letterhead or project intent is insufficient.
postal_system.identifier_split_rule: Recipient, organization, street, plot or property number, P.O. Box, private bag, Postnet agency number, poste restante, post office or delivery locality, five-digit postcode, national physical or digital address, ZILAS or ZNSDI plot identifier and AGID remain separate typed objects. P.O. Box 30136, 10101 Lusaka is a box, five-digit string and locality—not one identifier or proof of a property.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No rights-cleared nationwide official postcode catchment polygon release is bundled or identified. Post-office points, branch coverage statements, routing digits, provinces, districts, wards, national-addressing pilot areas, ZNSDI administrative layers, ZILAS or ZNSDI parcels, buffers, Voronoi cells, routes and model surfaces are not official postcode polygons; permitted generated surfaces remain derived non-canonical review geometry.
postal_system.address_rule: UPU and operator publications establish typed address structures and examples, not reusable customer rows. Store recipient, organization, street or village, plot or property number, P.O. Box, private bag, Postnet, poste restante, post office or locality, five-digit string, province, district and any operational national address with independent provenance, validity and visibility.
postal_system.building_rule: An exact building or parcel may be returned only from an exact rights-cleared artifact with a stable explicit operational national-address-to-building or cadastral relation. Postcode syntax, P.O. Box, private bag, address text, ZAMPOST-office proximity, ZNSDI parcel containment, nearest OSM building, overlap and model score are candidate context only.
postal_system.licence_rule: ZAMPOST pages, UPU publications and database rights, ZICTA and parliamentary materials, strategy documents, ZNSDI services, ZILAS records and government publications retain source-specific copyright, access and redistribution terms. Every artifact requires exact custodian, licence, version, access class, selected fields and digests; OSM remains in a separate attributed ODbL partition.
postal_system.privacy_rule: The Zambia Data Protection Act and Data Protection Commission guidance treat directly or indirectly identifying location data as personal data and require lawful, explicit, limited, accurate, retained and secured processing. Recipient, precise address, household, box or bag holder, property relation, plot or title, owner, resident, delivery and query-log data remain gated; cross-border transfer conditions also apply.
postal_system.hosting_rule: Cloudflare and Hugging Face may host only rights-cleared non-personal immutable artifacts pinned to releases or Hub commits with verified digests. Personal or restricted address, property, holder, owner, resident, credential and query material remains Zambia-hosted or otherwise gated and transferred only under an approved lawful cross-border basis.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Versioned crosswalks may relate permitted postcode observations, postal facilities, national addresses, administrative objects, parcels, buildings and derived review surfaces to AGID cells without relabelling an AGID cell as canonical Zambian postal, property or administrative geometry.
